summary: Retested both iteration_5 defects — BOTH CLOSED. (1) POST /api/chains/{id}/workspace/{gen} is now owner-filtered: owner gets 200 with workspace_path+files, a different X-Capcode-Session gets 404 'chain not found', no-identity gets 404, and a filesystem mtime/inode snapshot of /workspaces/<chain[:8]> proved the intruder wrote nothing. (2) Rater now returns real differentiated non-zero scores: 6 fresh builds across 2 runs all produced 5 numeric dims in 0-4 with composite 3.37-3.63 (never -0.1 or 0.0), exec.started=True. Full regression matrix re-run: 46/46 in test_ownership.py + test_security_fixes.py + test_auth.py pass (including the previously-failing test_workspace_endpoint_owner_scoped guard), and 4/4 e2e webgl build tests pass (SSE deltas, canvas/WebGL html, zip download). Startup log confirms 'rater validation ok: openrouter/openai/gpt-3.5-turbo'. No new regressions found.
